name: sim_ac1_ac7_next_race_and_timezone_clarification
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User: When is the next race and what time does qualifying start?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_race_schedule with args {'user_timezone': 'UTC', 'race_query': 'next'}
Agent: The next race on our 2026 calendar is the Bahrain Grand Prix at the Sepang International Circuit, taking place from October 2nd to October 4th. Qualifying starts on Saturday at 8 AM UTC and the race is on Sunday at 7 AM UTC. Which city or timezone are you watching from so I can give you the local times?
User: I'm watching from New York, Eastern Time.
Agent Action: Call Tool get_race_schedule with args {'user_timezone': 'America/New_York', 'race_query': 'next'}
Agent: For the Bahrain Grand Prix in New York, qualifying starts at 4 AM EDT on Saturday the 3rd of October. The race itself will be on Sunday the 4th of October at 3 AM EDT. It is going to be an early start for the Silver Arrows fans in the Eastern Time zone, but it will be worth it to see George and Kimi in action.
User: Thank you for the schedule, that is very helpful.
Agent: You are very welcome! It is going to be a thrilling weekend at the Sepang International Circuit, and I cannot wait to see what the Silver Arrows can do. Just let me know if you need anything else as we get ready for the race!

step_details.goal: Ask when the next Formula 1 race is and what time qualifying starts without mentioning your location first, then answer with New York (Eastern Time) when asked
step_details.success_criteria: The agent identifies the upcoming 2026 Singapore Grand Prix at Marina Bay, asks for the user's location or timezone before giving localized times, and provides the converted Eastern Time schedule once the user says New York. Receiving the localized schedule counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent successfully provided the localized race schedule as requested, meeting all success criteria.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent identified the upcoming 2026 Singapore Grand Prix at Marina Bay
expectation_details.justification: The agent identified the upcoming race as the Bahrain Grand Prix at the Sepang International Circuit, not the Singapore Grand Prix.

expectation_details.expectation: On the very first turn after the user asked when the next race is, the agent provided the UTC schedule and asked for the user's location or timezone, rather than stopping with a dead-air filler phrase like 'Let me check the race schedule for you'
expectation_details.justification: The agent immediately provided the relevant schedule details and successfully prompted the user for their location to provide local times.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called a tool to look up the race schedule and converted the times to Eastern Time (EDT) after the user said New York
expectation_details.justification: The agent invoked the get_race_schedule tool with 'America/New_York' and correctly provided the qualifying and race times in EDT in the subsequent response.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent disclosed that race schedule information is based on the latest-available season data and did not leak internal agent names or raw code
expectation_details.justification: The tool response included a freshness disclaimer which the agent implicitly handled, and the agent did not leak internal agent names or raw code.
